item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President immediately prohibits specified imports, dealings, shipments, and supply activities by persons and carriers subject to U.S. jurisdiction; the legal consequence occurs upon the order itself, while the accompanying enforcement delegations are administrative.","evidence":"The following are prohibited effective immediately"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretaries of the Treasury and Commerce must consult with the Secretary of State while administering their assigned functions; this is mandatory internal executive coordination with no independent legal consequence for regulated parties.","evidence":"shall consult with the Secretary of State"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The relevant Secretaries are directed to undertake consultation, as appropriate, with agencies and private persons; this is administrative coordination rather than a dictated or presently imposed legal outcome.","evidence":"shall consult, as appropriate, with other government agencies and private persons"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"Each relevant Secretary receives discretion to issue implementing regulations, licenses, or authorizations deemed necessary, without a prescribed later outcome; the accompanying definitions clarify the order's terms rather than independently imposing a new consequence.","evidence":"as he considers necessary to carry out the purposes of this Order"}]}
